network_error: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
unauthorized: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
not_found: Not found — it may have been deleted, or you're not a member of this ledger
forbidden: You don't have permission to do that
not_owner: Only the ledger owner can do that
stale_update: Someone just changed this. We've reloaded it for you.
use_transfer_endpoint: This is a paired transfer — edit both sides together
ledger_limit_reached: You've reached the limit of 10 ledgers
owner_must_transfer: Transfer ownership to someone else before you leave
cannot_remove_owner: You can't remove the ledger owner
member_not_found: That person isn't a member of this ledger
invite_rate_limited: Too busy right now — try again in a few seconds. Your code is still valid.
login_rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again later.
register_rate_limited: Too many sign-up attempts. Try again later.
import_rate_limited: You've used up this hour's imports (10). Try again later.
source_has_transactions: This account has transactions — archive it instead
currency_locked: An account's currency can't be changed — create a new account and archive the old one
same_source: The two sides of a transfer must be different accounts
repayment_target_not_credit: A card repayment must go into a credit card account
category_kind_mismatch: That category doesn't match this transaction type
kind_change_not_allowed: You can't switch between transfer and other types — delete and re-enter
refund_target_invalid: That original expense can't be linked
transfer_pair_incomplete: This transfer is missing one side. Reload and try again.

unpair_invalid: This transfer can't be unpaired — it doesn't have exactly two legs. Reload and try again.
skill_outdated: The category list changed — follow the import guide to update your skill, then re-generate this file
import_format_invalid: We couldn't read this file — its encoding, its # version: line, the header or a row's column count is wrong. The problem lines are listed below.
rows_exceed_limit: This file has more than 2000 rows — split it by month
batch_not_ready: This batch can't be changed right now — it may already be submitted, or some rows are still missing a date, amount, currency or type
batch_already_committed: This batch has already been submitted
rows_uncategorized: Some rows still need a top-level category
rows_all_skipped: Every row is skipped — there's nothing to submit
fx_unavailable: Exchange rates are unavailable right now
internal_error: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
